customManagers.description: The upstream iTerm2 source (components/iterm2/version): a release tag and its commit. SHA256 follows from DIGEST and must be updated with it; UPSTREAM_VERSION and components/iterm2-resources/version must move to the same release (build/prepare-inputs.sh refuses a mismatch).
The clang22 that compiles every target (components/clang22/version; clang22 on 10.9, clang22-cross on a modern Mac). build/prepare-inputs.sh refuses an installed release other than the pin.
Recaulk, whose sdk-metadata recipes give the 10.9 SDK the Foundation generic declarations the sources use. build/prepare-inputs.sh refuses an installed release other than the pin.

Longboat, which CI installs to get the 10.9 SDK the clang22 pkgs require (components/longboat/version, CI-only). Longboat tags YYYYMMDD.N; the versioning reads N as the minor, so two releases on one day order.

packageRules.description: Capped at 3.0.x: 3.1.0 requires OS X 10.10 (iterm2.com/downloads), and a build passing is not evidence of everyday use on 10.9. The cap ends when a newer upstream passes the Mavericks acceptance suite (spec: 2026-10-31-iterm2-design.md, advancement).
Renovate moves components/clang22/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside it, which fetch_clang22.sh needs on Linux.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, replace components/clang22/linux-sha256 with the `clang22-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` line of the new release's SHA256SUMS: `gh release download <version> -R Mavergreen/clang-22 -p SHA256SUMS -O - | grep linux-x86_64.tar.gz > components/clang22/linux-sha256`.
